$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit CLI family — AdapterInput. Major version 1. Per-run transport contract from the det core to an adapter subprocess (stdin, single JSON document). Transport only: converter payloads must never carry absolute filesystem paths (locator scheme whitelist), but the RUN needs to tell the adapter where the caller's checked-out source lives. Scopes bound the walk; the adapter must skip anything outside them (LOCATOR_OUT_OF_SCOPE) and any deny-listed surface (secrets, env/credential files).
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — Adapter Input (transport)

platformId.description: Must be one of the adapter's declared platformIds (checked by core before spawn).

sourceId.description: Profile-declared id; evidence locators in the returned registry reference it as source://<sourceId>/... .

path.description: Caller-supplied project root, realpath-resolved by core. Runtime transport only — never persisted into a contract payload.

include.description: Sorted, adapter-defined scope selectors bounding the walk.

options.description: Adapter-defined run options (open vocabulary). Nothing here may widen permissions beyond the profile's scopes or the deny list.
